title: Module categories over representations of SL_q(2) and graphs
note: Classifies indecomposable semisimple module categories over $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SL}_q(2))$ at generic $q$ by graphs; the rank-one module categories are the fibre functors, matching Bichon's $B(E)$ classification. Cited alongside bichon2003 for the same eightfold front-2 result. Added 2026-09-03. Verified 2026-11-24 against the Project Euclid / International Press publisher record and zbMATH 1053.17010 (qou-zx95): Mathematical Research Letters 11(1) (2004), pp. 103-114, DOI 10.4310/MRL.2004.v11.n1.a10; arXiv preprint math/0302130 (v1, 2003-02-11).
